name: Polymarket probability-velocity belief-shock momentum — ride a fast risk repricing
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from polymarket-positioning-risk-flip, which trades the LEVEL of pm_implied_prob; this trades its DERIVATIVE / velocity): pm_prob_velocity is the speed at which a prediction market is repricing a macro/risk event — a clean, bounded (~-0.31..+0.35, mean 0), point-in-time read on how fast collective beliefs are moving. When a risk-ON event's odds are rising FAST (positive velocity), informed prediction-market money is updating toward a benign macro outcome BEFORE that conviction shows up in the slower, more crowded crypto spot tape — a cross-market belief shock that crypto, the highest-beta risk asset, follows. The velocity (a change) is stationary where the level is not, so a fitted threshold on it is honest. Entry: pm_prob_velocity above a fitted positive shock floor (beliefs repricing risk-on, fast) AND price in a non-broken uptrend (don't fight a falling tape). Exit: velocity crosses DOWN through ~0 (the repricing has stalled — the belief shock is spent) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if the unconditional trend long matches the deflated Sharpe, the velocity gate adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: velocity is the first difference of pm_implied_prob; if entering on the pm_implied_prob LEVEL alone does as well, this is polymarket-positioning-risk-flip re-skinned and adds no orthogonal SPEED information. Disconfirmer 3 (data depth + breadth): only ~392 points and the market is a single aggregate gauge (market-wide, not per-symbol) — low-confidence, paper-only until it deepens. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 prediction-market feature.
catalyst: a fast positive repricing of risk-event odds — a belief shock crypto follows
